10 mushroom species in our organic indoor farm in California.

We grow on organic whole oats providing nutritious food for all the mushroom species we grow. The oats are digested by the mycelium as the mushroom grows before it's time to harvest. 
WHOLE FOOD MUSHROOMS
Our minimally processed, full-lifecycle mushrooms provide a full spectrum of active compounds to support optimal health.
